findings.title: Panic on validation error in view
findings.message: The gallery view builds the full navigation page and the inputs page on every render, and sets Focus only for the inputs page. The tab page for navigation may never receive focus. This is minor, but the Sidebar View panics on any validation error, which can crash the gallery.
findings.suggestion: Return an error node instead of panicking.

findings.title: Inconsistent decoration validation
findings.message: ValidateControl rejects icons and badges unless the control is a multiple ListBox, but the spec and the new Option doc say badges and icons decorate ListBox rows in general. Single ListBox with Badge is rejected, while validateListBox validates Badge for single lists too (dead path).
findings.suggestion: Align the doc and the validation, or state in the doc that only multiple ListBox is supported.

findings.title: Option equality used for stale check
findings.message: The staleness check compares Option structs with `old == o`, which works only while Option is comparable. Option has fields such as Closable and possibly funcs or slices. If any non-comparable field is added or already exists, this fails to compile or panics. The check also makes a model edit to a badge revoke navigation for that item.
findings.suggestion: Compare only the ID and Disabled fields, or the ID against the captured snapshot.
